goal: Logging in code review: useful log lines, the right level and no personal data.
use: Logging in code review: useful log lines, the right level and no personal data. Use when logging statements are added or changed.

steps.note: List log calls. Collect each log line in the change.
Check level. Flag errors logged as info and noise logged as error.
Check content. Flag personal data, tokens or full request bodies.
Check context. Each error line needs the identifiers to find the cause.
Report. Each line with file, the problem and the fix.
